entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, I need to return these useless cycling shoes I bought from you. This is completely unacceptable!
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. Can I start with your name and order number, please?
The name is Sam Jones, order number 8675309. And you're damn right I'm not satisfied! These things have given me the worst blisters I've ever had. They're garbage.

Thank you, Sam. I'm pulling that up now... I see the order for the Pro-Level cycling shoes, delivered 51 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the cleats or more of a sizing and comfort problem?

Are you kidding me? The problem is they're defective! They don't fit right, the cleats feel loose, and my feet are destroyed. I'm not going to debate this with you, I want a full refund. Now. Or I swear I will light up every review site on the internet. Get me your manager!
Sir, there's no need for that. I can absolutely handle this for you. I understand you're frustrated, and I apologize for the trouble you've had. Let me just confirm our policy for you.
You'd better. Your own website says 90 days. Don't even try to give me some runaround.

You are absolutely correct. Our return policy for standard items like these shoes is 90 days. Since you received them 51 days ago, you are well within the window. I can process this return for a full refund right away. There's no problem at all.
Oh. So you're actually going to do it? Fine. How do I send them back?

I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, your refund will be issued.
Alright. Make sure it gets done.
I will, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
